subject: ⚠️ Overdue Book Reminder - University Library
body:
Dear $student_name,

This is a reminder that you have an overdue book that needs to be returned to the University Library.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
OVERDUE BOOK DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Book Title: $book_title
Book ID: $book_id
Due Date: $due_date
Days Overdue: $days_overdue
Current Late Fee: $current_fine

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

ACTION REQUIRED:
Please return the book as soon as possible to avoid additional late fees. Late fees continue to accrue at £$daily_fine per day.

IMPORTANT:
• Return the book to any library location
• Library hours: Monday-Friday 8:00-20:00, Saturday-Sunday 10:00-18:00
• Use the after-hours book drop if needed
• Contact us if you're having difficulty returning the book

Need help?
Contact the library at library@university.edu or call us during business hours.

Best regards,
University Library Team
